[ASSISTANT_SAID] Building a gaming PC can offer more customization and flexibility.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For 144Hz monitors, a GPU should produce at least 144 FPS in games at high graphics settings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended graphics cards for 144Hz monitors:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070: Excellent performance, features like DLSS and ray tracing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti: Slightly more powerful than RTX 3070, with 8 GB GDDR6X VRAM.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080: High-end option for 4K gaming, with 12 GB GDDR6X VRAM.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT: Strong competitor to RTX 3070, with features like Radeon Image Sharpening.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT: More powerful option with 16 GB GDDR6 VRAM, suitable for 1440p and 4K gaming.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Consider other factors like monitor response time, CPU, and system RAM when building a gaming PC.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hope this helps you in your quest for the perfect gaming PC!
